verdict.rationale: Cactus ships official bindings for Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, React Native, Python and Rust, plus an OpenAI-compatible engine API. A Python package (needle) offers a decorator-based tool API, and the hosted platform can be driven from the CLI, Python or a coding agent. A community user called the React Native API very simple, though another flagged that models download inline at runtime with no separate download/cache API. Missing for 10: in-depth per-language SDK documentation (bindings appear only as a one-line list), an evidenced SDK for the hosted platform API beyond Python, and a separate model download/cache API.
